opportunities.description:
About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

  • Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

  • Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

  • Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

  • Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

  • Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

  • Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

  • Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

  • Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

  • Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

  • Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

  • Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

  • AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

  • Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

  • At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

  • Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working in a large, established codebase

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

  • Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

  • Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

  • High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

  • Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

  • Temporal or another durable workflow engine

  • React Native

  • Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

  • Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

  • Open-source work or internal tools that other people use

If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

Location and employment

This is a full-time employee role, remote and based in Toronto, Ontario. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

opportunities.title: VP of Brand and Communications
opportunities.description:
About Oscilar

Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platformâ¢ for banks and fintechs, reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance and onboarding in the AI era.

Our platform brings decisioning, data and AI agents together in one system, so risk teams can make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex work. Agent Hub gives them 30+ specialized AI agents across fraud, AML, credit, onboarding, sanctions and disputes.

Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions, including SoFi, MoneyGram and Nuvei, and makes tens of billions of risk decisions a year. ARR has grown 15x in the last 2 years.

Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, which went public at a valuation of about $10 billion and later agreed to be acquired by IBM for $11 billion.

The Role

We're hiring our first VP of Brand and Communications to lead Brand, PR and Communications and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

You'll own how Oscilar shows up in the market: the story we tell, the voice we tell it in, and where it gets heard. That means directing our PR to land Oscilar in Tier 1 publications and keep a steady drumbeat of coverage around every launch and milestone; defining a brand voice and guidelines that make us instantly recognizable as the agentic risk platform; launching brand campaigns that get financial services leaders talking; and turning our founder's industry profile into reach with the buyers we sell to.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy for brand, PR and comms, and personally get the first versions of the most important work out the door. You'll lead our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our PR agencies from day one, hire your first team member soon after joining, and build the team as results come in. You'll also build the playbook for an AI-native brand function, using agents and automation so a small team can do far more than its size suggests.

You'll report to Tomas Lobo, VP of Marketing and Growth, and work closely with our CEO and executive team, Product Marketing, Growth, Events and Design. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on Oscilar's growth and reputation.

What You'll Own

Brand Strategy & Category Leadership

  • Own Oscilar's brand strategy end to end, and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

  • Work with our founders to sharpen the agentic risk narrative, and turn it into a point of view the market repeats back to us.

  • Turn executive alignment into a cohesive brand voice and brand guidelines, and make sure the brand shows up consistently across the website, sales, content, social and events.

  • Evolve the brand as the company grows: new products, new markets and new audiences.

  • Own the brand budget and investment plan, and decide where each dollar builds the most awareness and trust.

  • Make sure Oscilar shows up in AI search and LLM answers, not just traditional search and media.

PR & Communications

  • Set the bar for what great PR looks like, and direct our agencies (including Highwire) to get there.

  • Land Oscilar's story in Tier 1 publications such as Fortune and the Wall Street Journal.

  • Build a steady drumbeat of earned media around product launches, customer stories, company milestones and timely news.

  • Build lasting relationships with the media, analysts and industry voices that shape our market.

  • Run PR as the long game it is, while making sure Oscilar shows up in today's conversations.

  • Own crisis communications readiness and the corporate narrative around major company moments.

  • Partner with People on our employer brand, so the story we tell the market also attracts great talent.

Social Strategy

  • Own Oscilar's social strategy across founder-led, executive-led, employee-led and company channels.

  • Make each channel amplify the others, so a single story travels from Neha to our executives, our employees and the company page.

  • Build an employee advocacy program that turns our team into a distribution channel.

  • Measure social by reach and engagement with the buyers we sell to, not vanity metrics.

Founder & Executive Presence

  • Manage Neha's presence across social media, video, media, podcasts and events, building on her 50K followers and her standing in the industry.

  • Own her roadmap of speaking, media and social moments, so she shows up in the right places at the right time.

  • Build the platforms that make Neha and our executives and experts the voices people seek out on AI, fraud, credit and compliance.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Set the long-term content strategy that builds Oscilar's authority in AI and risk: original research, data assets, signature franchises and executive points of view.

  • Bring Product Marketing, PR and content together around one shared plan, so every launch and campaign tells part of the same story.

  • Build content that compounds over time and becomes the reference point for our industry.

Brand Campaigns & Programs

  • Launch fast, high-ROI brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. Our first is the Agents of Risk awards program.

  • Run several bets in parallel, set clear goals for each, measure results, and decide quickly what to scale or stop.

  • Turn what works into flagship programs, partnerships and experiences that become recognized across financial services.

Team & AI-Native Operations

  • Lead and grow our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our agency partners from day one.

  • Build the Brand, PR and Communications team over time, adding your first hire soon after joining and growing the function as results come in.

  • Build an AI-native function: automate brand, PR and social workstreams with agents so a small team can do far more.

  • Define the function's priorities, operating rhythm and how we measure brand impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You've set the brand and PR strategy, are directing our agencies with a clear point of view, and have early wins on the board: earned media around our launches, a brand voice the company has adopted, and the first brand campaigns live and measured.

  • First year: Oscilar is recognized as the defining name in agentic risk. We have Tier 1 coverage and a steady drumbeat of earned media, a social presence that reaches the buyers we sell to across founder, executive, employee and company channels, and flagship programs the industry looks forward to.

  • Long term: You've built a high-performing, AI-native Brand, PR and Communications team, and brand has become one of Oscilar's biggest competitive advantages.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in brand, PR and communications, including leading brand and PR or comms at VP or Head-of level at a successful, sales-led B2B SaaS company.

  • Deep PR judgment. You've directed agencies to Tier 1 coverage and know what great looks like.

  • You've built a brand voice and guidelines that teams actually used, and you can take a messy draft and make it sharp.

  • You've run fast, measurable brand campaigns alongside long-term programs.

  • You're a hands-on player-coach: proactive, responsive, and quick to ship rather than theorize.

  • You're AI-native and have automated real marketing work with AI tools or agents.

  • You've managed experienced people and agencies, and aligned teams such as PMM and content on one plan.

  • You've owned a brand budget and managed creative teams and agencies across PR, design and video.

  • Clear, concise communication and strong creative instincts.

Bonus Experience

  • Selling to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, security or other risk and trust buyers.

  • Running a founder-led social program, especially for a technical founder.

  • Launching an awards program or other industry-recognition campaign.

  • Building a brand or comms function from scratch, or leading through a major moment such as an IPO or large announcement.

Why This Role Is Unique

  • Build from scratch, without the typical startup risk. You'll build Oscilar's brand function from the ground up at a company that already has product-market fit and has grown ARR 15x in 2 years.

  • A proven, second-time founder. Work directly with Neha Narkhede, who co-created Apache Kafka and co-founded Confluent, taking it to a roughly $10 billion IPO and an $11 billion acquisition agreement with IBM.

  • A manager who has done this before. Tomas Lobo helped build Samsara from $1M to close to $500M in ARR in about 5 years.

  • A category to name. Help define agentic risk, a new category at the intersection of AI, risk and financial infrastructure.

  • Room to build. A VP title, a seat with the founders, a PR partner already in place, and room to hire and build your team.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

  • Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents. (US)

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment; regular team events and offsites.

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Impact: Help make the internet safer by protecting online transactions and building the infrastructure powering the future of financial risk.
